pairs: Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam a Domino,
The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord,
dicens:
saying:
Surge,
“Rise up
et descende in domum figuli,
and descend into the house of the potter,
et ibi audies verba mea.
and there you will hear my words.”
Et descendi in domum figuli,
And I descended into the house of the potter,
et ecce ipse faciebat opus super rotam.
and behold, he was making a work on the wheel.
Et dissipatum est vas quod ipse faciebat e luto manibus suis:
And the vessel, which he was making with his hands out of clay, broke.
conversusque fecit illud vas alterum,
And turning away, he made another vessel,
sicut placuerat in oculis ejus ut faceret.
for it had been pleasing in his eyes to make it.
Et factum est verbum Domini ad me,
Then the word of the Lord came to me,
dicens:
saying:
Numquid sicut figulus iste,
“Am I not able to do with you,
non potero vobis facere, domus Israël?
O house of Israel, just as this potter has done,
ait Dominus:
says the Lord?
ecce sicut lutum in manu figuli,
Behold, like clay in the hand of the potter,
sic vos in manu mea,
so are you in my hand,
domus Israël.
O house of Israel.
Repente loquar adversum gentem
Suddenly,
et adversus regnum,
I will speak against a nation and against a kingdom,
ut eradicem,
so that I may uproot,
et destruam,
and destroy,
et disperdam illud:
and scatter it.
si pœnitentiam egerit gens illa a malo suo quod locutus sum adversus eam,
If that nation, against which I have spoken, will repent from their evil,
agam et ego pœnitentiam super malo quod cogitavi ut facerem ei.
I too will repent from the evil that I have decided I would do to them.
Et subito loquar de gente et de regno,
And soon, I will speak about a nation and about a kingdom,
ut ædificem et plantem illud.
so that I may build and plant it.
Si fecerit malum in oculis meis,
If it does evil in my sight,
ut non audiat vocem meam,
so as not to listen to my voice,
pœnitentiam agam super bono quod locutus sum ut facerem ei.
I will repent of the good that I have said I would do to it.
Nunc ergo dic viro Juda,
Now, therefore,
et habitatoribus Jerusalem, dicens:
speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
Hæc dicit Dominus:
saying: Thus says the Lord:
Ecce ego fingo contra vos malum,
Behold, I am forming an evil against you,
et cogito contra vos cogitationem:
and I am considering a plan against you.
revertatur unusquisque a via sua mala,
Let each one of you return from his evil way,
et dirigite vias vestras et studia vestra.
and direct your ways and your intentions well.”
Qui dixerunt:
And they said:
Desperavimus:
“We have lost hope.
post cogitationes enim nostras ibimus,
And so we will follow our own thoughts,
et unusquisque pravitatem cordis sui mali faciemus.
and each of us will act according to the depravity of his own evil heart.”
Ideo hæc dicit Dominus:
For this reason,
Interrogate gentes:
thus says the Lord:
Quis audivit talia horribilia,
“Inquire among the Gentiles.
quæ fecit nimis virgo Israël?
Who has heard of such horrible things as the virgin of Israel has done to excess?
Numquid deficiet de petra agri nix Libani?
Do the snows of Lebanon fail to fall on the rocks of the field?
aut evelli possunt aquæ erumpentes frigidæ,
Or are the cold waters, which burst forth and flow down,
et defluentes?
able to be rooted out?
Quia oblitus est mei populus meus,
Yet my people have forgotten me,
frustra libantes,
offering useless libations,
et impingentes in viis suis,
and stumbling in their ways,
in semitis sæculi,
in the paths of the world,
ut ambularent per eas in itinere non trito,
so that they walk by these on an unmarked route.
ut fieret terra eorum in desolationem,
And so their land has been given over to desolation
et in sibilum sempiternum:
and to perpetual hissing.
omnis qui præterierit per eam obstupescet,
Each one who passes by will be astonished
et movebit caput suum.
and will shake his head.
Sicut ventus urens dispergam eos coram inimico:
Like a burning wind, I will disperse them in the sight the enemy.
dorsum, et non faciem,
I will show them the back,
ostendam eis in die perditionis eorum.
and not the face, in the day of their perdition.”
Et dixerunt:
And they said:
Venite,
“Come,
et cogitemus contra Jeremiam cogitationes:
and let us devise a plan against Jeremiah.
non enim peribit lex a sacerdote,
For the law will not perish from the priest,
neque consilium a sapiente,
nor counsel from the wise,
nec sermo a propheta:
nor a sermon from the prophet.
venite,
Come,
et percutiamus eum lingua,
and let us strike him with the tongue,
et non attendamus ad universos sermones ejus.
and let us pay no attention to any of his words.”
Attende, Domine,
Attend to me,
ad me,
O Lord,
et audi vocem adversariorum meorum.
and hear the voice of my adversaries.
Numquid redditur pro bono malum,
Should evil be rendered for good?
quia foderunt foveam animæ meæ?
For they have dug a pit for my soul!
Recordare quod steterim in conspectu tuo ut loquerer pro eis bonum,
Remember that I have stood in your sight, so as to speak on their behalf for good,
et averterem indignationem tuam ab eis.
and to avert your indignation from them.
Propterea da filios eorum in famem,
Because of this,
et deduc eos in manus gladii:
give their sons over to famine,
fiant uxores eorum absque liberis,
and bring them to the hand of the sword.
et viduæ:
Let their wives be widows without children.
et viri earum interficiantur morte:
And let their husbands be slain by death.
juvenes eorum confodiantur gladio in prælio:
Let their youths be stabbed with the sword in battle.
audiatur clamor de domibus eorum:
Let an outcry be heard from their houses.
adduces enim super eos latronem repente,
For you will lead the robber upon them suddenly.
quia foderunt foveam ut caperent me,
For they have dug a pit, so that they may seize me,
et laqueos absconderunt pedibus meis.
and they have hidden snares for my feet.
Tu autem,
But you,
Domine,
O Lord,
scis omne consilium eorum adversum me in mortem:
know all their plans against me unto death.
ne propitieris iniquitati eorum,
May you not forgive their iniquity,
et peccatum eorum a facie tua non deleatur:
and do not allow their sin be taken away from your face.
fiant corruentes in conspectu tuo;
Let them be thrown down in your sight,
in tempore furoris tui abutere eis.
in the time of your fury, so that you may destroy them.
